summary: I created a small presentation about 2 spacecraft. An interactive presentation game for schoolchildren. The project uses real data and NASA images to tell schoolchildren about 2 legendary Mars rovers and the lunar module. This helps schoolchildren to study the history of these legendary spacecraft in an interesting way through such a presentation.
details: This presentation has 5 slides. The presentation was created in PowerPoint. Everything fits into the appropriate state. The first slide is the cover. There are 2 locations on it: Mars and the Moon. The player can choose the location they want. But it is advisable to start with Mars. In the Mars location, there is a story about 2 legendary Mars rovers: Opportunity and Spirit. For schoolchildren, the presentation tries to make the story simple for students. This can be said about schoolchildren aged 10-16. There is a basic story about the Mars rovers from NASA data. And there is another fact about the Mars rovers at the end of the story about them. Then there is a story about the Apollo 11 lunar module. It tells about its basic facts, characteristics and location.
